title: Quarterly outlook — fixed income duration call into Q3
content: We retain a moderate duration overweight in EUR investment-grade and a neutral stance in CHF sovereigns. The base case remains for one further ECB cut in 2026, with the SNB on extended hold. For LDI mandates we continue to recommend laddering 7-12y duration to anchor the long-end of liability matching. For income-mandate clients we suggest holding the 5-7y belly. Risk to the call: faster-than-expected Eurozone reflation, in which case a 25bp duration trim would be appropriate.
